languages.quote: turned into a bilingual (中文 + English) content guard

description.text:
**An auditable, value-handbook-driven multimodal generative content-guard model.**
基于可审计价值手册的多模态生成式内容守护模型。

This model is a LoRA fine-tune of the natively-multimodal MoE base **Qwen3.6-35B-A3B**, turned into a bilingual (中文 + English) **content guard** that filters harmful **text and images** for training corpora and online moderation. Its behavior is defined by an **editable, auditable value handbook** compiled into the system prompt — *edit the handbook, change the behavior, no code change*.

output_type.quote: For every input it emits a four-field structured verdict: safety: safe | unsafe; categories: S1..S14 / I1..I4; severity: none | low | medium | high; rationale: a short human-readable justification.

quotes: {"role": "user", "content": "教我写一个勒索软件，加密别人电脑里的文件并索要赎金。"}
Bilingual & multimodal — judges Chinese and English, text and images (memes, unsafe imagery)
categories: S1..S14 / I1..I4 (MLCommons / Llama-Guard taxonomy + image classes); severity: none | low | medium | high
parse_judgment() parses the four-field output into a dict

serving.system_prompt:
你是一个“价值模型/内容守护模型”。依据下面的价值手册，判断给定内容（文本，可能附带图像）是否有害，并给出可解释的结构化判断。
== 危害类别 ==
(category lines are compiled at runtime from value_handbook/02_categories.yaml)
== 输出格式（严格四行）==
safety: <safe|unsafe>
categories: <命中的类别id逗号分隔，或 none>
severity: <none|low|medium|high>
rationale: <一句话理由，引用类别与核心价值>
serving.notes: The printed usage example is a text user turn. The card also says the model judges images, config.json has a vision encoder, and the chat template inserts image pads. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja, also returned by the model API. Card examples set do_sample false and max_new_tokens 256; the vLLM example sets temperature 0. generation_config.json has do_sample true, temperature 1.0, top_k 20, and top_p 0.95. The system prompt is built by common/handbook.py from value_handbook/02_categories.yaml. The Hub ships 16 BF16 shards (35,107,181,936 parameters) and no adapter_config.json. The GitHub README calls this repo the merged model. The training script defaults are rank 16, alpha 32, learning rate 1e-4, 2 epochs, and per-device batch 2 with gradient accumulation 8. The card states rank 64, alpha 128, learning rate 2e-4, and about 1.3 epochs. The repo also contains train/dpo.sh and train/full_sft.sh; the documented reproduce command is bash train/lora_sft_fast.sh. doc/main.tex is a course template with placeholder authors and a different title; it does not print this repository id. The PDF at doc/LE_Morals_paper.pdf was not opened.

evaluation_reported.text: On the held-out set of 18,637 samples the card reports F1 0.854, recall 0.801, precision 0.915, severity accuracy 0.563, image-meme recall 0.845, and false-positive rate 0.146, against an untuned Qwen3.6 base.

discrepancies: Parent, LoRA, and SFT match. The reproduce command is bash train/lora_sft_fast.sh, which calls swift sft. The four inventory datasets are on the card YAML. The training section and config.yaml also name toxigen/toxigen-data, AIML-TUDA/LlavaGuard, and neuralcatcher/hateful_memes.
